Criminal Application (Aba) No.240 Of 2026
 Gajendra Madhukar Balapure Vs. State of Maharashtra
__________________________________________________________________
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram,
appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's orders
and Registrar's Orders.

Shri Anil Mardrikar, Sr. Advocate a/b Shri S.M. Vaishnav,
 Advocate for applicant.
Shri A.M. Ghogare, App for respondent/State.

Date : 30.03.2026.
 1. The applicant is apprehending his 
 connection with Crime No.147/2026 registered with Police
 Station, Ural, District Akola for the offence punishable under
 Section 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
 2.

The contention of the applicant is that the allegation  against the Secretary (present applicant) and Sarpanch of  the Gram Panchayat, Lohara is that   misappropriated funds by showing purchase of multiple  movable properties.
The movable property that was  purchased is lying with the concerned department for which  it was purchased and an affidavit to that effect has been  placed on record.

3. Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on  15.04.2026.
 4.
Shri Ghogare, learned APP waives service of notice on  behalf of the non-applicant and prays for time to file reply.

Considering the submissions and the nature of  allegations, a detailed scrutiny of the case diary is necessary,
 which is not available at present.
In the meanwhile, the  applicant can be granted ad interim protection.

Hence, the  following order:

sentences.text: (i) Pending the application, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.147/2026 registered with Police Station, Ural, District Akola for the offence punishable under Section 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the applicant - Gajendra Madhukar Balapure be released on bail on furnishing a PR bond of 25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station on Wednesday and Saturday between 10.00 am to 12.00 noon for the next two weeks and cooperate with the investigating authority.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not threaten the prosecution witnesses.

(M.W. Chandwani, J.) Wagh Gajendra Madhukar Balapure vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr Pso., Ps ... on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10054756/
